notes: Reviewed and returned unchanged in its units and heads; only two notes were sharpened, on s001 and s003.
Every s### and t### id is partitioned exactly once.

s001's *a … man* is discontinuous under rule 15; the intervening *doubleminded* is not absorbed, being s002's own word. The governing rule for placing the supplied *a* on the noun rather than the adjective is 58, which the accepted note did not name — both source words are anarthrous, so 58's case is exact and the reading is unchanged.

The only contestable unit is s006/s008. αὐτοῦ is unspent, so rule 20 proper applies and the article is unrepresented rather than taking *his* under rule 76. The competing reading — article takes *his*, pronoun unrepresented — is not defensible here, since rule 76 turns on the pronoun having been spent on some other English role and it has not.
s003 ἀκατάστατος is an alpha-privative but is rendered by a single English word, so rule 84 is not engaged and the head is not in doubt.

No copula is written anywhere in the verse, so rules 53, 63, 68 and 96 are all inert; the source gloss's bracketed *[He is]* on s001 is interlinear apparatus, not ASV text, and no target token answers to it.
